items.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11
items.q: That band was uh Joe Oliver, Freddy Keppler, Manuel Perez. See. Big Eye Louie on clarinet. It was a very good brass band.

ctx.x: When we were down here, Joe was playing over on Rampart Street, I think. You know where Woolworths is now, Rampart and Canal? Yeah. Remember Tom Anderson's and all used to be, the cabaret. I worked in the Black Cat those days. He was playing around there in Tom Anderson's, I think, Joe Voyager. Because that's where the cabarets used to be, not Boyfriend Street. On Rampart and Iverville.
Joe's brother was a drummer, Louie, huh?
He had a brother, a drummer.
